title: claytonia media
intro: Claytonia media, commonly known as miner's lettuce or winter purslane, is a species of flowering plant in the family Portulacaceae. This plant is rich in nutrients and has been used for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion. Its therapeutic actions include acting as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, which may contribute to its traditional use in treating various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of Claytonia media include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ascorbic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
